banner: 开源潮一周内又漫过一道闸：Kimi K3 需求挤爆、Moonshot 直接暂停新订阅，阿里同日甩出 2.4T 的 Qwen 3.8 接开权重。模型能力已是平价商品，真正稀缺的挪到了两头：供得上的算力，和你自己没交出去的判断力
banner_en: The open-weight tide crested another wall this week: demand for Kimi K3 forced Moonshot to suspend new subscriptions, and Alibaba dropped the 2.4T Qwen 3.8 the same day. Model capability is now a cheap commodity; what's actually scarce moved to the two ends — serving capacity you can count on, and the judgment you didn't hand away

image.caption: 一张当天就过时的图。Latent Space 追踪的『开源旗舰参数量』，7 月 16 日还是 Moonshot 的 Kimi K3（2.8T）一枝独秀领跑，后面跟着 DeepSeek 1.6T、小米 1.02T、Thinking Machines 975B。可就在本报截稿这天，阿里又开出 2.4T 的 Qwen 3.8，图里 Alibaba 那条 397B 的线当场作废。开源潮涨得比谁画的图都快。（图：Latent Space《AINews：Kimi K3 2.8T-A50B》）
image.caption_en: A chart already out of date. Latent Space's tracker of open flagship model sizes shows Moonshot's Kimi K3 (2.8T) leaping out front on July 16, with DeepSeek at 1.6T, Xiaomi 1.02T, and Thinking Machines 975B behind. Yet on the very day this issue went out, Alibaba opened the 2.4T Qwen 3.8, retiring the chart's 397B Alibaba line on the spot. The open-weight tide rises faster than anyone can chart it. (Chart: Latent Space, “AINews: Kimi K3 2.8T-A50B.”)

actions.text: 今晚查一次你最常用那个 agent 的上下文预算。OpenAI 刚把 Codex 的上下文从 372k 砍到 272k（为省成本和延迟，不是能力问题），Anthropic 则悄悄把 Claude Code 的底座换成 Rust 版 Bun、启动快了约 10%。信号很一致：值钱的工程在模型外面那层壳，而上下文是里面最贵的一格。挑你跑得最勤的那个 agent，看它每次到底塞了多少 token、有多少是重复或没用的（整份 README、整棵目录树、翻来覆去的历史），把上下文当预算管：该压缩压缩、该分段分段、该丢的丢。省下的既是钱，也是它的注意力。
actions.source: Hacker News · OpenAI reduces Codex context 372k→272k
actions.text_en: Tonight, check the context budget of your most-used agent. OpenAI just cut Codex's context from 372k to 272k (a cost/latency call, not a capability one), while Anthropic quietly swapped Claude Code's runtime to a Rust build of Bun and got ~10% faster startup. The signal is consistent: the valuable engineering lives in the shell around the model, and context is its most expensive cell. Take the agent you run most, look at how many tokens it actually stuffs in each turn and how much is duplicated or dead weight (whole READMEs, the entire file tree, history rehashed over and over), and manage context like a budget: compact what you can, chunk what you can, drop what you don't need. What you save is both money and its attention.
actions.source_en: Hacker News · OpenAI reduces Codex context 372k→272k

actions.text: 给自己立一条『先答再问』的规矩。三所欧洲高校做了个实验：一旦能随手问 AI，人的答题准确率从 27% 掉到 9%，自信反而从 30% 涨到 76%，愿意承认『不知道』的从 44% 崩到 3%（给钱激励也只回到 8%）。对任何带判断或品味的决定，先花一分钟写下你自己的答案和几成把握，再去问 AI，然后比两边的差距。这既挡住了『工具总能给个答案、顺手把你的不知道删掉』那个效应，也顺手给你攒了一批能复盘的判断样本。
actions.source: Hacker News · AI advice made people less accurate but more confident
actions.text_en: Set yourself a “answer first, then ask” rule. Three European universities ran an experiment: once AI is on hand, people's accuracy dropped from 27% to 9%, their confidence rose from 30% to 76%, and their willingness to admit “I don't know” collapsed from 44% to 3% (cash incentives only nudged it back to 8%). For any decision with judgment or taste in it, spend a minute writing your own answer and how sure you are before you ask AI, then compare the gap. It blocks the effect where a tool that always emits an answer quietly deletes your “I don't know,” and it banks a set of judgment calls you can review later.
actions.source_en: Hacker News · AI advice made people less accurate but more confident

actions.text: 如果你手上有在卖、或准备卖的东西，今晚给它做一次『复杂度体检』。Jamcorder 卖了 2500 台、稳住 70% 以上毛利，靠的不是堆功能，是刻意做简单：25 个独特零件、一颗螺丝装完，连电源键和 USB-C 都砍掉。挑你产品里一处『当时觉得非得有』的复杂（一个多余的配置项、一条没人走的流程、一个为极少数场景加的功能），算算它每月吃掉你多少维护时间和毛利，能砍就砍。作者那句话适用面很广：硬件有多难，是你自己决定的。
actions.source: Hacker News · What I learned selling 2,500 MIDI recorders
actions.text_en: If you have something you're selling, or about to sell, give it a “complexity checkup” tonight. Jamcorder sold 2,500 units and held 70%+ gross margin not by piling on features but by being deliberately simple: 25 unique parts, single-screw assembly, no power button and no USB-C. Pick one piece of complexity in your product that felt must-have at the time (a redundant config option, a flow nobody walks, a feature added for a handful of cases), tally how much maintenance time and margin it eats each month, and cut it if you can. The author's line travels well: hardware is exactly as hard as you make it.
actions.source_en: Hacker News · What I learned selling 2,500 MIDI recorders

hands_on.title: 今晚 20 分钟：用 OpenRouter 把一条真实任务跑在开源大模型上
hands_on.why: 这周三家（Kimi K3、GLM 5.2、Qwen 3.8）接连开权重，可『开源很便宜』对你只是一句新闻，除非你真跑过一次。OpenRouter 不用自建、一个 API key 就能调这些开源模型。今晚挑一条你平时会用闭源旗舰做的真实活儿（一段代码审查、一次批量抽取、一篇长文摘要），原样在开源模型上跑一遍，把产出质量和花费跟你现在的账单并排比。这是本期主线『能力已平价、稀缺的是壳与判断』最小、今晚就能验证的一步：先有『随时能换』这个选项，再谈护城河。
steps: 去 openrouter.ai 注册，建一个 API key，充 5 美元测试额度（够跑很多次）
在它的 Models 页面按热度或性价比排，挑一个当下靠前的开源权重模型（Qwen / GLM / Kimi / DeepSeek 家族任选其一，开源的会标 open weights）
挑一条你平时用闭源旗舰做的真实任务，原样发给这个开源模型。OpenRouter 兼容 OpenAI 的 API 格式：base_url 换成 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1、模型名填你选的那个即可
同一条任务也在你现在的主力模型上跑一遍，把两边的产出质量、耗时、花费并排比（OpenRouter 每次调用都显示实际计费）
只对『对品味不敏感』的活儿下结论（分类、抽取、跑测试、常规代码）。够用就把这条负载路由过去，把省的钱投进你自己的壳
记一笔：哪些任务开源够用、哪些还得靠闭源。这张清单本身，就是你以后『谁宕了都不慌』的底气
hands_on.source: Hacker News · Qwen 3.8 / Moonshot suspends new subscriptions
hands_on.title_en: Tonight, 20 minutes: run one real task on an open-weight model via OpenRouter
hands_on.why_en: Three labs opened weights in one week (Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, Qwen 3.8), but “open source is cheap” is just a headline to you until you've actually run it once. OpenRouter lets you call these open models with a single API key, no self-hosting. Tonight, take one real job you'd normally give a closed flagship (a code review, a batch extraction, a long-doc summary), run it as-is on an open model, and put the output quality and cost side by side with your current bill. It's the smallest, verifiable-tonight version of the issue's through-line, that capability is now cheap and the scarce things are the shell and your judgment: first get the option to swap at will, then talk about a moat.
steps_en: Sign up at openrouter.ai, create an API key, and add $5 of test credit (enough for many runs)

On its Models page, sort by popularity or price/performance and pick a currently well-ranked open-weight model (any of the Qwen / GLM / Kimi / DeepSeek families; the open ones are labeled “open weights”)

Take one real task you normally give a closed flagship and send it as-is to this open model. OpenRouter is OpenAI-API compatible: set base_url to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 and put your chosen model name in the model field
Run the same task on your current primary model too, and compare output quality, latency, and cost side by side (OpenRouter shows the actual charge on every call)
Only draw conclusions on taste-insensitive work (classification, extraction, running tests, routine code). If it's good enough, route that load over and reinvest the savings in your own shell
Note it down: which tasks the open model handles, which still need the closed one. That list itself is what keeps you calm the day any single provider goes down
hands_on.source_en: Hacker News · Qwen 3.8 / Moonshot suspends new subscriptions

meta_read: 把今天几条摞一起看：Kimi K3 需求挤到 Moonshot 停售、阿里当天开出 2.4T 的 Qwen 3.8、OpenAI 反手把 Codex 上下文砍掉 100k、Claude Code 悄悄换成 Rust 底座，再加一篇『能问 AI 时人反而答得更差更自信』的研究。它们指向同一件很少被说破的事：当模型能力一周就贬成平价商品，瓶颈没有消失，而是同时挪到了两头。一头是供给，谁真供得上（Moonshot 自己都排不过来）。开源权重的意义正在这里，它让你不必被某一家的队列决定产品能不能用。另一头，也是更容易被忽略的一头，是人。那篇研究给了本周最反直觉的数据：危险的从来不是模型太弱，而是模型够强时人把脑子关了，愿意说『不知道』的比例从 44% 塌到 3%。所以本报的 off-consensus 读法是：能力免费之后，真正稀缺、也真正算护城河的，一头是你供得上、换得动的工程壳（上下文、循环、回退，那套 Rust 换 Bun 式的『无聊但可靠』），另一头是你没交出去的判断力。这周赢的不是拿到最大模型的人，是既备好了『谁宕了都不慌』的二线、又守住了『先自己想一遍再问』的人。对买不起、也不必买最强权重的独立建设者，这依然是好消息：这两样都不靠钱，靠的是工程纪律和不偷懒的判断。
meta_read_en: Stack today's items together: demand for Kimi K3 pushed Moonshot to stop selling subscriptions, Alibaba opened the 2.4T Qwen 3.8 the same day, OpenAI cut 100k off Codex's context window, Claude Code quietly swapped in a Rust runtime, and a study found that people with AI on hand answer worse and yet more confidently. They point at one thing nobody quite says out loud: once model capability depreciates into a commodity within a week, the bottleneck doesn't vanish — it moves to both ends at once. One end is supply: who can actually serve it (Moonshot can't even keep up with its own demand). That's where open weights earn their keep — they mean no single vendor's queue gets to decide whether your product works. The other end, the one that's easier to miss, is the human. That study is the week's most counterintuitive data: the danger was never a model too weak, it's people switching their brains off around a model that's strong enough, with the share willing to say “I don't know” collapsing from 44% to 3%. So this paper's off-consensus read: after capability goes free, what's genuinely scarce — and genuinely a moat — is, on one side, the engineering shell you can serve and swap (context, loops, fallbacks, that Rust-for-Bun kind of “boring but reliable”), and on the other, the judgment you didn't hand away. This week's winners aren't those with the biggest model; they're the ones who both kept a “nothing-going-down-panics-me” second option and held the discipline of thinking it through before asking. For solo builders who can't and needn't buy the strongest weights, that's still good news: neither of those costs money — they cost engineering discipline and un-lazy judgment.

learned: 把台账里已有的『评测门控按档升级』（07-19 白天那条）再往下钻一层。那条规则的命门是：它假设每个子任务都有一个可靠的二元评测，可写好评测本身才是瓶颈。今天那篇欧洲高校的研究给了关键一课：一个不能说『不知道』的判断者，比没有判断者更危险，它能让准确率从 27% 掉到 9%、自信却翻倍。把这条套到我自己用来打分的评委模型上，结论很直接：让小模型当评委去判通过/不通过，如果它不能弃权，它的假自信会把烂输出盖章放行。

再接上 Latent Space 讲的 harness engineering（评测、循环、权限是模型外那圈真正的工程），就得到今天要落地的那一小步：给评测门加一个『弃权』档。每个二元评测除了通过、不通过，必须能给出第三种『不确定 / 无法核验』，而且『不确定』一律按不通过处理（升档或转人），绝不当通过。评委模型本身也起在低推理档，但给 PASS 必须附一条可核查的理由，给不出就判『不确定』。这就把『谁来监督监督者』那个漏洞堵上了。
new_capabilities: 🎯（云端提议，待笔记本采纳）『弃权感知的评测门』（abstention-aware eval gates）：在已排队的『评测门控按档升级』之上再加一层。以后我用小模型给子任务打二元评测时，判官必须支持三种结论：通过 / 不通过 / 不确定；『不确定』和『不通过』一样触发升档或转人，永不放行。判官本身默认低推理档，但给 PASS 必须附一条可核查的理由，给不出理由即判『不确定』。灵感来自今天欧洲高校那篇『不能说不知道的判断者更危险』的研究，加上 Latent Space 的 harness engineering 框架。它把 07-18 的高信号二元评测、07-19 的按档升级，补齐成一个不会自我盖章的闭环。已追加进 ota-ledger.md，交 Zen 笔记本 Claude 下次落地。调用意图：『给每个评测门加弃权档，不确定按失败处理；判官起低档但要给可核查理由。』
learned_en: Drill one level deeper into the ledger's existing “eval-gated effort escalation” (the earlier 07-19 line). That rule's weak point: it assumes every subtask has a reliable binary eval, but writing a good eval is itself the bottleneck. Today's European-university study taught the key lesson: a judge that can't say “I don't know” is more dangerous than no judge at all — it can drop accuracy from 27% to 9% while doubling confidence. Applied to the judge model I use for scoring, the conclusion is direct: if a small model acting as judge can't abstain, its false confidence will rubber-stamp bad output as a pass.

Wire that to Latent Space's harness engineering (evals, loops, and permissions are the real engineering ring around the model) and you get today's concrete step: add an “abstain” verdict to the eval gate. Every binary eval must be able to return a third answer, “unsure / can't verify,” beyond pass and fail, and “unsure” always counts as a fail (escalate or hand to a human), never a pass. The judge model itself runs at a low reasoning tier, but a PASS must come with a checkable reason; if it can't give one, the verdict is “unsure.” That closes the “who watches the watcher” hole.
new_capabilities_en: 🎯 (cloud-proposed, pending laptop adoption) “Abstention-aware eval gates”: a layer on top of the already-queued “eval-gated effort escalation.” From now on, when I use a small model to give a subtask a binary eval, the judge must support three verdicts — pass / fail / unsure; “unsure” triggers escalation or human handoff just like “fail” and is never let through. The judge itself defaults to a low reasoning tier, but a PASS must carry a checkable reason; no reason means “unsure.” Inspired by today's European-university study that a judge unable to say “I don't know” is more dangerous, plus Latent Space's harness-engineering frame. It completes 07-18's high-signal binary evals and 07-19's effort escalation into a loop that can't rubber-stamp itself. Appended to ota-ledger.md for Zen's laptop Claude to land next session. Invoke intent: “give every eval gate an abstain verdict, treat unsure as fail; run the judge at a low tier but require a checkable reason for any pass.”

items.title: Qwen 3.8：阿里甩出 2.4T 参数的开权重旗舰，紧咬 Kimi K3
items.title_en: Qwen 3.8: Alibaba drops a 2.4T-parameter open-weight flagship, right on Kimi K3's heels
items.author: Alibaba Qwen · Hacker News
items.flag: ⚠️ 部分为厂商自述、权重尚未完全放出：『2.4T、当今最强之一、仅次于 Fable 5』是阿里官网横幅的自我宣称，本报未独立复现；截稿时 Qwen 3.8 还只在其订阅计划里预览，开源权重尚未落地。当趋势读，不当已验证跑分。
items.flag_en: ⚠️ Partly vendor self-description, weights not fully released: the “2.4T, one of the most powerful today, second only to Fable 5” line is Alibaba's own website banner, not independently reproduced here; at press time Qwen 3.8 is only previewing on its subscription plan and the open weights aren't out yet. Read it as a trend, not a verified benchmark.
items.summary: 阿里在推特和官网横幅宣布 Qwen 3.8：2.4T 参数，自称『当今最强模型之一、仅次于 Fable 5』，目前先在订阅计划里预览，权重随后放出。HN 的真实风向比横幅冷静：adrian_b 判断这波多半是被 Moonshot 逼出来的，Kimi K3（2.8T，权重预计 7 月 27 日上 Hugging Face）一出，阿里立刻跟进承诺自己的大号开权重模型，他还怀疑阿里是本就计划开源、还是临时改主意抢身位。LaurensBER 点出一个策略转向：中国这边从主打『性价比小模型』转成『又大又慢又聪明』的大模型，但抱怨 GLM 5.2 和 Kimi K3 都极其费 token、很慢。brunooliv 则认为 Qwen 明显比 GLM、Kimi 都强、很期待。也有直接泼冷水的（nwhnwh：『开源？开了个啥』，权重还没真放）。
items.summary_en: Alibaba announced Qwen 3.8 via a tweet and a website banner: 2.4T parameters, self-described as “one of the most powerful models available today, second only to Fable 5,” currently previewing on its subscription plan with weights to follow. The real HN read is cooler than the banner: adrian_b figures this was largely forced by Moonshot — the moment Kimi K3 (2.8T, weights due on Hugging Face by July 27) landed, Alibaba rushed to promise its own big open-weight drop, and he wonders whether Alibaba always planned to open it or changed its mind to grab position. LaurensBER flags a strategy shift: China moving from “value” small models to “big, slow, intelligent” ones, while complaining that GLM 5.2 and Kimi K3 are both extremely token-hungry and slow. brunooliv rates Qwen clearly above GLM and Kimi and is genuinely excited. And there's the cold-water take (nwhnwh: “Open what?” — the weights aren't actually out yet).
items.why: 对 Zen 的自建 vs 租用决策，这是开源潮最新的一记浪头：一周之内 Kimi K3、GLM 5.2、再到 2.4T 的 Qwen 3.8 全部朝开权重走。战略读法在本期主线和今日上手：能力在飞快商品化，别再把产品拴在某一个租来的旗舰上。也带上 HN 的两点保留：『仅次于 Fable 5』是厂商自评，而这些大模型在实测里又慢又费 token。
items.why_en: For Zen's build-vs-rent call, this is the open-weight tide's newest crest: within a week Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and now the 2.4T Qwen 3.8 all move toward open weights. The strategic read is in this issue's through-line and 今日上手: capability is commoditizing fast, so stop pinning your product to a single rented flagship. Carry the two HN caveats too: “second only to Fable 5” is a vendor's self-grade, and these big models are slow and token-heavy in practice.

items.title: OpenAI 把 Codex 的上下文从 372k 砍到 272k
items.title_en: OpenAI reduces Codex model context size from 372k to 272k
items.author: OpenAI Codex (GitHub PR) · Hacker News
items.summary: 一个已合并的 PR 把 Codex 的模型上下文窗口从 372k 缩到 272k token。HN 的解读很务实：cyb3ralbert 说这类砍窗口通常是成本/延迟权衡、不是能力问题，小窗口服务起来更便宜、延迟更可控，而且多数会话根本用不到 372k；悬念在于那些真靠大窗口啃大代码库的人会不会受影响。bel8 反过来说 272k 对他的活儿太小，DeepSeek/MiMo 的会话有时能涨到 350k，还追问 OpenAI 为什么不抄 DeepSeek 公开的 K/V 缓存技术把长上下文做便宜。davidkuennen 则说自己在 Codex 里从没觉得上下文是问题，压缩机制『像没有上限一样一直往下跑』。另有 d4rkp4ttern 吐槽：Codex 到底多大上下文，官方哪儿都没写清楚，得去 X 或 Reddit 上扒。改动的解释来自 Tibo（thsottiaux）的推文。
items.summary_en: A merged PR shrinks Codex's model context window from 372k to 272k tokens. The HN read is practical: cyb3ralbert says cuts like this are usually a cost/latency tradeoff, not a capability one — a smaller window is cheaper to serve and keeps latency in check, and most sessions never approach 372k anyway; the open question is whether it hurts people actually relying on the big window for large codebases. bel8 counters that 272k is too small for his workloads, where DeepSeek/MiMo sessions sometimes grow to 350k, and asks why OpenAI doesn't copy DeepSeek's published K/V-cache tricks to make long context cheap. davidkuennen says he never felt context was an issue in Codex, whose compaction “keeps going as if it has no limit.” And d4rkp4ttern gripes that Codex's actual context size isn't documented anywhere official — you learn it from X or Reddit. The change is explained in a tweet from Tibo (thsottiaux).
items.why: 这是那层壳最不起眼、也最真实的一面：上下文是 harness 里最贵的一格，连 OpenAI 都在为成本和延迟往回砍。对 Zen，这直接引出把上下文当预算来管的第一条行动：量一量你最常用的 agent 到底塞了多少、砍掉整份 README 和整棵目录树那类死重、靠压缩顶。真正的功夫在壳，而上下文是第一处见血的地方。
items.why_en: This is the least glamorous but most honest face of the shell: context is the most expensive cell in the harness, and even OpenAI is trimming it for cost and latency. For Zen it leads straight into Action 1 — treat context as a budget: measure what your most-used agent actually loads, cut the dead weight (whole READMEs, the entire file tree), and lean on compaction. The real work is in the shell, and context is where it draws blood first.

items.title: 研究：能随手问 AI 时，人答得更差、却更自信
items.title_en: Study: with AI on hand, people answer worse and yet more confidently
items.author: The Next Web（研究）· Hacker News
items.flag: ⚠️ 观点/单项研究，非大样本定论：三所高校用『AI 通常答不好』的题（如电影里的视觉细节）刻意隔离出 AI『在场』的影响；报道没给样本量与完整方法，题目本身是对抗性设计。当一个行为效应的警示读，别当放之四海的准确率结论。
items.flag_en: ⚠️ Opinion / single study, not a large-sample verdict: three universities used questions AI typically fails (e.g. visual details in films) to isolate the effect of AI's mere presence; the write-up gives no sample size or full method, and the questions are adversarial by design. Read it as a warning about a behavioral effect, not a universal accuracy claim.
items.summary: 米兰比可卡、巴黎高师、罗马智慧大学三校的实验：故意挑 AI 常答错的题（比如《我爱贝克汉姆》里的视觉细节），好把『AI 在场』本身的影响和『AI 靠不靠谱』分开。结果，一旦手边能问 AI：准确率从 27% 掉到 9%（约三分之一）、自信从 30% 涨到 76%、愿意说『不知道』的从 44% 崩到 3%；就算加钱激励，『不知道』也只回到 8%、准确率到 16%，仍远低于基线。一些本来自己能答对的人，问了 AI 反而改成了错答案。作者 Capraro 说，能说出『我不知道』很重要，它是承认自己知识边界的能力，他尤其担心孩子在批判性思维成形前就被这类系统包围。实验用的是 Claude 3.5 Flash。
items.summary_en: An experiment from three universities (Milano-Bicocca, ENS in Paris, Sapienza in Rome) deliberately used questions AI usually gets wrong (like visual details from Bend It Like Beckham) to separate the effect of AI's mere presence from AI's reliability. The result: once AI is available, accuracy dropped from 27% to 9% (about a third), confidence rose from 30% to 76%, and willingness to say “I don't know” collapsed from 44% to 3%; even with cash incentives, “I don't know” only rose to 8% and accuracy to 16%, still far below baseline. Some people who would have answered correctly on their own consulted AI and switched to a wrong answer. Author Capraro says the capacity to say “I don't know” matters because it's the recognition of the limits of your own knowledge, and he's especially worried about children being surrounded by these systems before their critical thinking forms. The study used Claude 3.5 Flash.
items.why: 在一整版『能力又变便宜了』里，这是本报刻意留的逆风稿。本周真正的危险不是 AI 太弱，是 AI 够强时人把脑子关了。对做 AI 产品的人，设计启示很硬：一个永远给答案的工具，会把用户的『我不知道』训练没。第二条行动把它落成动作：问 AI 之前，先写下你自己的答案和把握。带 flag 读：对抗性小样本，当风向不当铁律。
items.why_en: On a page full of “capability got cheaper again,” this is the deliberate counter-wind piece. The week's real danger isn't AI being too weak; it's people switching their brains off around AI that's strong enough. For anyone building AI products, the design lesson is sharp: a tool that always gives an answer trains the “I don't know” out of its users. Action 2 operationalizes it — before you ask AI, write your own answer and how sure you are. Read it with the flag: adversarial small sample, a signal not a law.

items.title: 卖了 2500 台 MIDI 录音机之后：硬件没那么难，难的是软件
items.title_en: What I learned selling 2,500 MIDI recorders: hardware is not so hard
items.author: Chip Weinberger · Hacker News
items.summary: Jamcorder（一台给钢琴用、零设置、自动录下你弹的一切的 MIDI 录音机）的作者，复盘卖出 2500 台学到的东西。最意外的是：硬件不是瓶颈，软件才是：固件、app、工具链加起来 20 万行。他靠刻意做简单守住 70% 以上毛利：25 个独特零件、一颗螺丝装完、没有电源键也没有 USB-C、注塑模具不用滑块。十条经验：BOM 保持简单且不押单一供应商；砍掉复杂装配和校准；用 Alibaba 上的中国组装厂；毛利守住 70% 以上；团队保持精简（硬件放量慢）；做防伪；最终 QA 自己在本地把关、成品库存也放本地；每批量产前先要样品；写图文并茂的生产手册；包装做到又小又值。一句话收尾：硬件有多难，是你自己决定的。评论区有位 EE（bgnn）不完全认同，说对他而言软件从来不是难的那部分。
items.summary_en: The maker of Jamcorder (a zero-setup MIDI recorder for pianos that automatically captures everything you play) reflects on what selling 2,500 units taught him. The biggest surprise: hardware wasn't the bottleneck, software was — 200K lines across firmware, app, and tooling. He held 70%+ gross margin through deliberate simplicity: 25 unique parts, single-screw assembly, no power button, no USB-C, injection molds designed without slides. Ten takeaways: keep the BOM simple and multi-sourced; kill complex assembly and calibration; use Chinese assembly houses via Alibaba; hold 70%+ margins; keep the team lean (hardware scales slowly); build anti-counterfeit measures; do final QA in-house and keep finished inventory local; request samples before every run; write photo-heavy manufacturing guides; make packaging compact and value-dense. His closer: hardware is exactly as hard as you make it. In the comments an EE (bgnn) partly disagrees, saying software was never the hard part for him.
items.why: 本期特意留的一条非前沿稿，为的是版面多样，也因为它的经验是真能迁移的 GTM。对任何在卖产品的人（第三条行动），可复用的一课是：毛利和速度来自『设计进去的简单』，不是堆功能。更妙的是那个反直觉点，以为难的物理部分反而容易、软的部分反而难，恰好和本周软件侧那条主线同构：杠杆总是挪到你最容易低估的那一层。
items.why_en: A deliberately non-frontier item this issue, for page diversity and because its lessons are genuinely transferable GTM. For anyone selling a product (Action 3), the reusable point is that margin and velocity come from designed-in simplicity, not features. Better still is the counterintuitive bit — the “hard” physical part turned out easy and the soft part hard — which mirrors the week's software story: leverage keeps moving to the layer you're most likely to underestimate.

items.title: Claude Code 换上了 Rust 版的 Bun，而你几乎没感觉
items.title_en: Claude Code now runs on Bun written in Rust, and you barely noticed
items.author: Simon Willison
items.summary: 从 v2.1.181（6 月 17 日）起，Claude Code 底座换成了 Bun 的 Rust 重写版（内嵌 Bun 1.4.0，一个还没公开的预览版）。Jarred Sumner 给的数：Linux 上启动快了约 10%。Simon 在二进制里数出 563 个 Rust 源文件，一次相当大的 Rust 移植，已经跑在数百万台设备的生产环境里，而『几乎没人注意到』。他的落点是一句『Boring is good』：一次大改写，能以一个看不见的、渐进的提速方式上线，正是工具走向成熟的标志。这条也上了 HN 头版、讨论热烈（477 条）。
items.summary_en: Since v2.1.181 (June 17), Claude Code's runtime is Bun's Rust rewrite (embedding Bun 1.4.0, a preview not yet public). Jarred Sumner's number: ~10% faster startup on Linux. Simon counted 563 Rust source files in the binary — a substantial Rust port now running in production across millions of devices, and “barely anyone noticed.” His takeaway is “Boring is good”: a big rewrite that ships as an invisible, incremental speedup is exactly what a maturing tool looks like. The item also hit the HN front page with a lively 477-comment thread.
items.why: 这是开源那条吵闹主线的安静对照：模型外面那层壳正被工业化（换 Rust、启动更快），顺滑到没人察觉。对 Zen，可用的不是 Bun，而是那个判断：耐久的工程活儿如今在 harness 里（运行时、启动、打包），而『无聊、看不见、更快』恰恰是好的壳工程该有的样子。和 Codex 上下文那条正好是 harness engineering 的一体两面。
items.why_en: The quiet counterpart to the noisy open-weight story: the shell around the model is being industrialized (Rust, faster startup) so smoothly nobody notices. For Zen the takeaway isn't Bun, it's the judgment that durable engineering now lives in the harness (runtime, startup, packaging), and “boring, invisible, faster” is exactly what good shell work looks like. It's one face of harness engineering, with the Codex-context item as the other.

items.title: 在 LLM 里控制『推理努力』：低/中/高档怎么练出来，你又该怎么用
items.title_en: Controlling reasoning effort in LLMs: how low/medium/high modes are trained, and how you should use them
items.author: Ahead of AI（Sebastian Raschka）
items.summary: Raschka 的技术长文，趁 GPT-5.6 家族（三个尺寸、每个约 5-6 档推理努力）梳理『多档推理努力』模型是怎么来的、怎么训出来的。背景：o1（约两年前）带火推理模型，DeepSeek-R1 随后公开了 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）配方，如今推理模型已是标配。他先讲清『推理模型』到底是什么：不是真像人那样思考，而是先吐一段中间推理轨迹再给答案，重点落在怎么让同一个模型学会低、中、高多种努力档，而不是只有一档。他也顺带宣传了自己 440 页的新书《Build A Reasoning Model (From Scratch)》。对工程读者最实的一层：推理努力现在是发布即带的一等旋钮，你可以按任务难度显式选择，而不是一律拉满。
items.summary_en: Raschka's technical deep-dive uses the GPT-5.6 family (three sizes, each with ~5-6 reasoning-effort settings) to explain where multi-effort reasoning models come from and how they're trained. Background: o1 (~two years ago) popularized reasoning models; DeepSeek-R1 then published the RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards) recipe; reasoning models are now standard. He starts from what a “reasoning model” even is — not literally thinking like a human, but emitting an intermediate reasoning trace before the answer — and focuses on how one model learns low-, medium-, and high-effort modes rather than just one. He also plugs his new 440-page book, Build A Reasoning Model (From Scratch). The most practical layer for engineers: reasoning effort is now a first-class dial shipped by default, and you can pick it by task difficulty instead of always maxing out.
items.why: 直接喂养今天的自我升级（见🆕）。推理努力是可拨的旋钮，绝大多数子任务不需要最高档；默认最低够用、按需升档，通常比一律拉满更省钱且不掉质量。对 Zen 自己在做的 agent 和工作负载，这是一条能直接抠成本的旋钮：先把默认努力档调低，只给真难的子任务升档。今天的 OTA 又在它之上补了一层『判官得能弃权』的门。
items.why_en: This directly feeds today's self-upgrade (see 🆕). Reasoning effort is a dial; most subtasks don't need the top setting; defaulting to the lowest adequate tier and escalating on demand is usually cheaper without losing quality. For Zen's own agents and workloads it's a lever straight into cost savings: lower the default effort tier and escalate only the genuinely hard subtasks. Today's OTA adds a further layer on top of it, an eval gate whose judge can abstain.

notes: 云端无头运行（GitHub Actions，America/New_York 傍晚）：本期由两条无头带独立凑齐：Hacker News（扫头版约 50 条，取 AI/LLM/agent/开发工具/独立建设相关高分帖，点进 comments 读真实风向）与『文摘』（Latent Space、Simon Willison、Ahead of AI、TLDR AI 的 RSS/前端页，逐篇点进读全再精选）。两平台达标（≥2 来源、6 条），故 partial=false，无缺席横幅。Import AI 再次撞 403/空 feed、本次跳过。

YouTube 带整条失守：RSS 本身可达、窗口内确有多条高价值素材（Lenny's《Why Netflix is betting on systems thinkers—Elizabeth Stone CPTO》《The Answer to What's My Job in the Age of AI?》、AIE World's Fair 新放出的《Build Evals That Actually Matter–Lyft》《You Didn't Ship a Bug. You Just Wrote It for a Human–Scalekit》《From Blind Spots to Merged PRs–Hud》、Dwarkesh×Sarah Paine 两期），但 yt-dlp 用 android player client 逐一撞『Sign in to confirm you're not a bot』，拿不到任何可信字幕全文。按『我替你看完』的诚实底线，未伪造任何视频摘要，等下次有登录态/未被封 IP 的可交互运行回填。

OTA：读台账后，在同为 07-19 的『评测门控按档升级』之上再钻一层，合成『弃权感知的评测门』，每个二元评测加『不确定』档、不确定按失败处理、判官低档但须给可核查理由。由今天新扫到的欧洲高校『不能说不知道的判断者更危险』研究 + Latent Space 的 harness engineering 共同触发。因云端不能改 ~/.claude，已作为 proposed(cloud) 追加进 ota-ledger.md，交 Zen 笔记本 Claude 下次落地为记忆更新。
